messages:
alex: Heads-up — sprint next week includes provisioning for 3 new customer orgs (EU, US, APAC). Putting a preflight checklist here. Need quick answers on GPU quotas, IPs, and billing/project layout.

maya: +1. Do we want separate projects per org or a single shared billing project with per-org folders?

alex: prefer separate projects per org for clear billing and IAM scoping. folder structure: /customers/{org-name} -> projects {org-prod, org-dev}.

devin: Agree on projects. Quick infra notes: regional GPU availability varies — H100 scarce in eu-west1 this week. For predictable throughput we should request A100 quota in eu-west4 and us-west1 as fallback.

sophia: Tagging question for product: what cost center tag do we enforce? we need tags for feature billing and sandbox separation.

liam: finance prefers tags: cost_center, business_unit, customer_id. Please add sample tag values in the checklist.

alex: draft checklist snippet:
```
- org creation: folder/customer-{id}
- projects: customer-{id}-prod, customer-{id}-dev
- billing: link projects to customer-{id}-billing-account
- IAM: groups: infra-{customer-id}-admins (roles/editor), infra-{customer-id}-ops (roles/viewer + custom deploy roles)
- tags: cost_center=ml-team, business_unit=prod, customer_id={id}
- network: reserved external IPs (2), subnet CIDR /22, VPC peering if required
- GPU quotas: request A100 (1/2/4), fallback A10/Xeon if H100 unavailable
```

maya: note on networking: for private deployments we need a nat gateway with egress control and a route table that supports /22. Also request regional ephemeral IP pool if using cross-region testing.

quota-bot: Automated quota scan for customer-xyz: 
- us-west1: A100 quota 0 (recommended request: 4)
- eu-west4: A100 quota 2 (recommended request: 4)
- asia-southeast1: A100 not offered, recommend A10 or GA100 variant
- static IPs remaining: 28
Follow request form: https://redwood.internal/quota-requests (include Project ID, region, resource type, justification).

alex: thanks. maya — can you file the quota requests for eu-west4 + us-west1? include justification: "customer onboarding — guaranteed production capacity for inference". Mark as high priority.

maya: filing now. also cc-ing networking to reserve 2 static IPs per org in eu-west4 and us-west1.

devin: FYI — for autoscaling pools, add note: "reserve minimum 2 GPUs per pool to avoid cold-start latency". For spot/interruptible instances, add preempt tolerance config.

sophia: product to provide latency and availability SLOs to include in the request. I'll attach the SLO doc by EOD. :eyes:

liam: rough cost estimate request: tell me expected steady-state A100 hours per org so I can produce a burn estimate.

alex: aim for 8 A100-hours steady-state for prod (conservative), spike policy + burst to 32 for load tests. Add that to the quota justification.

maya: quota request submitted for eu-west4 (A100 x4) and us-west1 (A100 x4). Ticket #Q-4821. ETA from provider: 48-72h. Also routed to account team for expedited review.

quota-bot: Ticket Q-4821 created. Current status: pending. If expedited, contact cloud-sales@provider with Q-4821 and attach org billing_id.

devin: action items: maya -> submit quota + IP reservation (in-flight), alex -> finalize IAM groups and terraform snippets, sophia -> SLO doc, liam -> cost estimate.

alex: wrapping up — I'll push terraform example for project creation and IAM in #eng-infra-utils by EOD. Thanks all :thumbsup:

maya: noted. will follow up in #eng-infra when tickets update. :rotating_light:
